generalAbilities.name: Chemical Sense 60 feet
generalAbilities.description: A fuming sludge detects nearby living and undead creatures by their complex chemical compositions, but it can't detect elementals or other creatures composed of a single element.

generalAbilities.name: Smoldering Haze
generalAbilities.description:
15 feet. The fuming sludge constantly emits incendiary smoke that creates Concealment around it. The smoke doesn't impair the fuming sludge's chemical sense. A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn in the aura becomes Sickened 1 (DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw negates) and cannot recover from Persistent Fire Damage for 1 round. It is then temporarily immune to the sickening effect of the smoldering haze for 1 minute.

A creature that is currently holding its breath, that doesn't need to breathe, or that's immune to poison is immune to the aura's sickened effect but not the concealment or inability to recover from persistent fire damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(1d8+6) Bludgeoning Damage]{1d8+6 bludgeoning plus 1d8 persistent fire}, Basic DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cooling Glob
offensiveAbilities.description:
A fuming sludge's ejected globs cling to targets.

A creature hit by an ejected glob Strike is Encumbered for 1 round.

If the attack was a critical hit, the creature is instead Restrained for 1 round (Escape dc=24).

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
